subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/commands/query-batch.ts

M1_load_per_query._note: R1: run-query --batch has no second memo since the M13 finding; B14 counts loads by spy over TWO runs (first run's misses load per entry), B14c expects graphLoads=1 with two misses.

M2_load_per_query_counter_once._note: graphLoads stays 1 (the code lies about itself); only the independent loader spies see the extra loads — B1/B1c/R1 and B14 (spy over two runs). B14c does not see it: it reads graphLoads, which the mutant pins to 1. Extra after review round 1: B11 counts load ATTEMPTS with a spy on the loader (review of PR #4605, MEDIUM 1): a load per entry is seen there too.

M3_update_not_refused._note: Extra after review round 1: B3b holds the other update forms (DELETE DATA, PREFIX-led INSERT DATA); no refusal reddens both.

M4_stop_after_first_failure._note: B3, B13 and B13c are red too, legitimately: their FIRST entry fails (refused UPDATE / injected timeout); stopping drops the second entry, so the summary sits where the axis expects the second record. Extra after review round 1: B3b's first entry is refused; stopping there leaves its later entries unanswered.

M5_rc0_on_failure._note: finish() is shared by both verbs: R1/R6 (run-query --batch) and B13c read rc 5 too.

M6_entry_error_echoes_message._note: Extra after review round 1: M6 forwards every Error message; B8b holds the execution-error message (a literal the translator quotes).
